    Browse by category shelf, by place or event, by theme, or by the math lens you're teaching this week. Tap any card to play it.

    The six category shelves — 10 slots each in the finished bank

    Tap a shelf to filter to that category. Tap it again to show the whole bank. Empty shelves are honest slots — entries for them are in the pipeline, awaiting approval.

    Don't want to choose? Two ways to let the class decide: surprise everyone, or call on a student to pick a category.

    “Pick a category!”

    Call on a student, let them call it out, then tap their category. You'll get a random entry from that shelf in the current grade bank, straight into the player at Clue 1.
